content: Caprolactam is an organic compound classified as a cyclic amide, also known as a lactam. Its primary industrial application is as a monomer in the manufacturing process of nylon. The majority of caprolactam is produced through the chemical transformation of cyclohexanoxime via a Beckmann rearrangement reaction. Caprolactam is known to be an irritant and exhibits toxic properties when ingested, inhaled, or absorbed through the skin.
